productFit.name: HOOBS Box (HSLF-3)
productFit.variant: HOOBS Box HSLF-3 bought from the HOOBS shop (hoobs.com) with the 'Power Adapter' option set to EU-Plug (the shop also offers US-Plug, UK-Plug and USB-Cable Only). HOOBS says all EU orders ship from its Warehouse Germany, about 3 business days. The box itself is USB-C powered (5 V, up to 3 A), so only the plug adapter differs.
productFit.reason: HOOBS lists an EU-Plug adapter choice on the HSLF-3 product page and ships EU orders from Germany, so it is sold to DE/ES/NL. HOOBS prices are ex-VAT with customs/taxes the buyer's responsibility, per its shipping page. No ASIN or Amazon DE/ES/NL listing was confirmed (the English brief also notes the Amazon US listing is unconfirmed), so the localized post should point to hoobs.com and the EU-Plug option, not an amzn search. Not verified: whether Ring Alarm and the listed tested Ring accessories are the same hardware sold in the EU; the post should say the plugin works with the Ring account/cloud and the reader's own Ring devices.

localFacts.fact: The Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens says a camera or doorbell camera on a home may in principle not film the public road or the property of the user's neighbours; it advises talking to the neighbours first.
AP also publishes privacy rules and practical tips for cameras at your own home.
AP is reported to want a preventive approach to doorbell cameras after neighbour complaints.

A Rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant ruling (ECLI:NL:RBZWB:2024:9594) held the tenant should have asked the landlord's permission before hanging the cameras and ordered them removed after weighing interests. Court-specific; general information only.
Juridisch Loket says hanging a camera is not forbidden but gives steps for when a neighbour's camera films your home or garden.
HOOBS ships EU orders from its German warehouse in about 3 business days with an EU-Plug adapter option; customs and taxes are the buyer's responsibility, per HOOBS.

localPainPoints.pain: Renters in an apartment complex ask whether a camera doorbell is allowed at all when it can capture neighbours or shared space.
localPainPoints.fix: Local fact: AP's rule that the camera must not film neighbours' property or the public road; aim it only at your own doorstep and ask the landlord first.

quotes.text: Iemand mag alleen een camera of videodeurbel ophangen als die camera de bezittingen van buren en/of de openbare weg niet filmt.

localPainPoints.pain: Renters are unsure whether tenants can place cameras in shared space.
localPainPoints.fix: Local fact: Rechtbank ruling on asking the landlord first; put the bridge host inside the unit and do not film shared areas.

quotes.text: Wettelijk gezien mag je niet zomaar camera's plaatsen in de publieke ruimte.
